violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wet wiping cloth found stored on counter near sandwich prep area. Wet wiping cloths should be stored in a sanitizing solution or laundered.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Pop dispensers found with debris build up. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Multiple nonfood contact surfaces in the kitchen were found with food build up and debris. Sandwich and pizza prep tables were found with buildup. Reach-in cooler near hand sink found with debris. Counter under coffee bar and hot holding cabinets were found dirty. Shelving under hot hold cabinets and cupboards under coffee bar found with debris. Pizza oven vents found with debris. These areas should be cleaned more thoroughly and maintained clean.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in the proper location to protect from contamination. Utensils found stored in dirty drawers. Utensils should be stored in a clean location.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Donut boxes were found stored on a dirty shelf below self serve case. Single use items should be stored in a clean location.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Ceiling vents, tiles, and walls in kitchen were found dirty. Floor in walk-in off of kitchen storage area and in the storage area found dirty. Floor also found with build up under mixer and under equipment throughout the kitchen.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Uncovered pizza crust found in small walk-in freezer. Food items should be covered to protect from contamination.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Shelving units and outer surfaces of equipment were found dirty. Cabinets under coffee machines and Pepsi dispenser were also found dirty. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in the proper location to protect from contamination. Scoop drawer near the pizza oven was found dirty. Clean equipment should be stored in a clean location.
